reason: A multi-plugin DeepSeek Harness toolkit primarily extends and orchestrates agent behavior through prompt controls, memory context, execution guards, skill command execution, vision fallback, and image-generation tools; human review is warranted because it can execute installation and skill commands and read home-directory files.

summaries.zh: 一套为 DeepSeek Harness 扩展智能体编排能力的插件集合，提供提示词与语言控制、跨智能体记忆、视觉回退、执行守卫、生图工具及技能命令处理。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin suite that extends agent orchestration with prompt and language controls, cross-agent memory, vision fallback, execution guards, image-generation tools, and skill command processing.

capabilities: Modifies agent prompts and response-language behavior
Intercepts and conditionally blocks tool, file, and shell execution
Reads files from the user's home directory and injects them as model context
Registers image-generation tools that call external providers
Executes shell commands embedded in trusted skill files
Runs package build code during installation when explicitly authorized
